source_note: 利用连续函数的identity theorem证明函数方程
english_source_note: Functional Equations via the Identity Theorem
callout_id: 利用连续函数的identity theorem证明函数方程#3
statement_en: Let $f:\mathbb{R}\to \mathbb{R}$ be a continuous function such that for every real number $x$, $$f(x)=f(x+\sqrt{2})=f(x+\sqrt{3}).$$ Prove that $f(x)$ is a constant function.
key_techniques: density of the generated additive subgroup
prerequisites: basic irrationality and linear combination arguments
callout_body: 函数$f:\mathbb{R}\to \mathbb{R}$是一个连续函数，并且满足对任意的实数$x$都有$$f(x)=f(x+\sqrt{2})=f(x+\sqrt{3})$$证明函数$f(x)$是一个常函数。
